name: Add Leads to List
summary: Adds one or more leads to a static list (up to 300 IDs per call). Leads not found are skipped with a reason.
whenToUse: When you want to enroll specific people in a static list — e.g. a manual campaign audience or an exclusion list.

path.name: listId
path.label: List ID
path.hint: Find it via Get Static Lists.

query.name: id
query.label: Lead ID(s)
query.hint: Comma-separated lead IDs to add. Max 300 per call.

response.description: One status per lead ID: added/updated or skipped with a reason.

notes: Adding a lead that's already on the list is harmless — it just stays on the list.
This is a static list, so the membership won't change on its own (unlike Smart Lists).
